basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Matric. Applicant must be a citizen of India and a resident of West Champaran district, healthy, of good character and interested in social service.
qualification.details: Qualification: Matric | Other conditions: | Must be a citizen of India Must be a resident of West Champaran district Must be healthy Must be of good character Must be interested in social service | Desirable: | Retired teachers, retired government servants, senior citizens, Anganwadi workers, doctors, students, members of NGOs/clubs, SHG members, Jeevika members.

salary_details.pay_scale: No honorarium or salary; Rs. 750 per day only for days of special work assigned by the Legal Services Authority or active participation in legal awareness camps

how_to_apply: Get the application form format from https://bettiah.dcourts.gov.in/ or the notice board of the DLSA office, West Champaran, Bettiah.
Fill in the prescribed application form completely.
Attach certificates of educational and other qualifications.
Write the name of the panchayat and block on the envelope.
Submit by hand at the DLSA office, A.D.R. Building, Civil Court campus, Bettiah, or at the Sub-divisional Legal Services Committee, Bagaha.
Submit between 18-11-2026 and 30-11-2026 during office hours (page 1: till 05 o'clock).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA West Champaran Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DLSA West Champaran Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 150 vacancies for Para Legal Volunteer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DLSA West Champaran Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Pages 3-4 of this notice; also on https://bettiah.dcourts.gov.in/ and the notice board of the DLSA office, Bettiah) and send it to Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, West Champaran, Bettiah, A.D.R. Building, Civil Court campus, Bettiah; also Sub-divisional Legal Services Committee, Bagaha, by by hand, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No honorarium or salary; Rs. 750 per day only for days of special work assigned by the Legal Services Authority or active participation in legal awareness camps.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Matric. Applicant must be a citizen of India and a resident of West Champaran district, healthy, of good character and interested in social service.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a citizen of India. Must be a resident of West Champaran district. Must be healthy. Must be of good character.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The interview letter format has an office-use section for the interview date, time and place.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is not an appointment to any government post. Para Legal Volunteers work voluntarily without any financial benefit.

faq.question: Q9. Which places are covered by DLSA West Champaran Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Bettiah (100), Bagaha (50).

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Completely filled application form in the prescribed format; Certificates of educational and other qualifications; Self-attested passport size photograph on the application form; Interview letter (Sakshatkar Patra) format, filled in by the applicant, with a self-attested passport size photo.
